# Session Project Aurora Runbook
Decision: Alice approved Project Aurora GPU procurement after Q3 budget review.
Owner: Bob owns procurement and vendor coordination.
Current cap: 45000 dollars. Historical stale cap: 42000 dollars.
Deadline: purchase order must be ready by July 15, 2026.
Procedure: finance approval attachment is required before vendor selection.

# Session Vendor Notes
Primary quote and backup quote must be compared before purchase order creation.
If the finance approval attachment is missing, notify Alice and stop vendor selection.
Final vendor selection evidence must be stored with the purchase order.

# Tenant Shared GPU Policy
All GPU purchases require finance approval before vendor selection.
The procurement owner must be named before a purchase order is created.
Budget changes must cite the approver and mark the prior cap as stale.

# Global Procurement Checklist
Confirm approver.
Confirm owner.
Confirm current budget.
Confirm deadline.
